newsitem.title: DUBAI: Yemeni foreign minister leaves Saudi after talks.
newsitem.headline: Yemeni foreign minister leaves Saudi after talks.

text.p: Yemen's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdul-Karim al-Iryani left Saudi Arabia on Wednesday after talks that focused on efforts by the two countries to settle a border dispute, Saudi television said.
Iryani met Saudi Interior Minister Prince Nayef bin Abdul-Aziz and other officials during the two-day trip.

Yemen and Saudi Arabia had several minor clashes in a border area potentially rich in oil and gas before the two sides signed a memorandum of understanding last year to resolve the 60-year-old border dispute.
A landmark visit to Yemen by Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan in August appeared to put an end to years of tension and mistrust between the neighbouring countries.
